items.html: Rather, we shall now explain the three lower aspects, which are the surrounding light outside the NHY of Ima, from which, from their place, is made the aspect of the true surrounding light over the head of ZA. And being there above, they surround from above over all the skull of ZA, and over the inner Mochin within the cavities of the skull, which are the fifth aspect; and it surrounds and shelters over all of them from without. And being there, they are the aspect of four Mochin separate one from another, and it is recognizable in them that they are four Mochin, and they are called: Hochma, Bina, Hesed, and Gevura, as mentioned in the introduction to Bereishit and in Parashat Va'etchanan.
